taglineZh: 用 assistant-ui 原语搭生产级 AI 聊天界面
taglineEn: Build production AI chat UIs with assistant-ui primitives
descZh: 收录 assistant-ui 的 runtime 与组件分层文档、128 个成品界面元素和 starter 模板。在 React 应用里做聊天界面、给产品补 AI 助手面板、展示工具调用与审批卡时使用。产出组件组合方式、状态接线说明和可复制的 tsx 模板。
descEn: Packages assistant-ui docs on the runtime/primitive split, 128 ready-made UI elements, and starter templates. Use it when building chat interfaces in React, adding an AI assistant panel, or rendering tool calls and approval cards. Output is composition guidance, state wiring, and copyable tsx templates.
outputZh: 组件组合方案与 tsx 模板
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了一个 AI 助手线程：流式回复、工具调用审批卡与带附件的输入框。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows an AI assistant thread: streaming reply, tool-call approval card, and a composer with attachments.

taglineZh: 把界面、幻灯片、文档做成自包含 HTML 设计稿
taglineEn: Polished self-contained HTML design artifacts of any type
descZh: 一套完整的设计方法论，覆盖 UI 稿、原型、线框图、落地页、幻灯片、简历、动效等 13 类产物，支持导入 Figma、GitHub 或既有设计系统作为约束。需要设计、可视化或做 PPT 时使用。产出是自包含的 HTML 设计稿，幻灯片可导出为可编辑 PPTX。
descEn: A full design methodology covering 13 artifact types: UI mockups, prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, decks, résumés, animations and more, with imports from Figma, GitHub, or existing design systems as binding constraints. Use it for any design, visualization, or deck request. Output is self-contained HTML; decks export to editable PPTX.
outputZh: 自包含 HTML 设计稿
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了一张高保真移动端设计稿：画板、界面与设计标注。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows a hi-fi mobile design artifact: artboard, app screen, and design annotations.

taglineZh: Bootstrap 5.3.8 离线包与后台骨架落地手册
taglineEn: Offline Bootstrap 5.3.8 kit and admin-scaffold handbook
descZh: 把 Bootstrap 5.3.8 的编译产物、SCSS 源、42 个官方示例和 117 篇文档收进本地，断网可用。做 SaaS 后台、内部工具或双击即开的离线 HTML 原型时使用。产出是内联 dist 的单文件页面或基于官方示例的后台骨架。
descEn: Bundles Bootstrap 5.3.8 compiled dist, SCSS sources, 42 official examples, and 117 doc pages locally for offline use. Use it for SaaS admin panels, internal tools, or double-click-to-open HTML prototypes. Output is single-file pages with inlined dist or admin scaffolds based on official examples.
outputZh: 离线单文件 HTML / 后台骨架
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了一个 Bootstrap 风格管理端片段：侧栏、指标卡、订单表格与暗色切换。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows a Bootstrap-style admin fragment: sidebar, stat cards, an orders table, and a dark-mode toggle.

taglineZh: 先写美学宣言，再产出博物馆级视觉海报
taglineEn: Write an aesthetic manifesto, then render museum-grade art
descZh: 先创作一份 4-6 段的设计哲学宣言，再把主题作为隐晦的概念线索织入画面，产出以视觉为主、文字极少的 PNG 或 PDF 作品。做海报、艺术画、静态视觉设计时使用。产出是哲学 .md 文件加一张单页高完成度视觉作品。
descEn: First writes a 4-6 paragraph design-philosophy manifesto, then weaves the subject in as a subtle conceptual thread, producing PNG or PDF works that are 90% visual and 10% essential text. Use it for posters, art pieces, and static visual design. Output is a philosophy .md plus one meticulously crafted single-page artwork.
outputZh: 哲学宣言 + PNG/PDF 海报
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了一张由虚构美学运动驱动的观测风海报：重复弧线、克制配色与临床式标注。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows an observation-style poster driven by a fictional aesthetic movement: repeated arcs, a restrained palette, and clinical labels.

taglineZh: shadcn 合著的 16 类 React 组件构建规则
taglineEn: 16 rule categories for React components, co-authored by shadcn
descZh: components.build 规范，由 Hayden Bleasel 与 shadcn 合著，覆盖组合、可访问性、受控状态、多态、asChild、data 属性、CVA 样式与设计令牌等 16 类规则。新建或重构组件库、设计组件 API 时对照使用。产出是符合规范的组件 API 设计与实现代码。
descEn: The components.build specification co-authored by Hayden Bleasel and shadcn, covering 16 rule categories: composition, accessibility, controllable state, polymorphism, asChild, data attributes, CVA styling, and design tokens. Reference it when building or refactoring component libraries and designing component APIs. Output is spec-compliant API design and implementation.
outputZh: 组件 API 规范与实现
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了按规范构建的组件切片：CVA 按钮变体、复合卡片解剖与 data-state 开关。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows spec-built component slices: CVA button variants, compound-card anatomy, and a data-state switch.

taglineZh: 154 个 React 动效组件的选型与落地手册
taglineEn: Selection handbook for 154 React motion components
descZh: 收录 cult/ui 的 141 个组件源文件、153 个示例与分类索引，按风格族选件再拷源码进项目。Next.js/React + Tailwind + shadcn 项目要首屏标题、halo 发光、卡片光束、动态岛等动效时使用。产出是选件清单、依赖说明与接入项目的组件源码。
descEn: Packages cult/ui's 141 component source files, 153 examples, and a family-based index: pick a style family, then copy source into your project. Use it when a Next.js/React + Tailwind + shadcn app needs hero titles, halo glows, border beams, or dynamic-island effects. Output is a selection list, dependency notes, and integrated component source.
outputZh: 动效组件源码接入方案
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了 cult/ui 风格的动效组件：光束描边卡片、流光标题与渐变按钮。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows cult/ui-style motion components: a border-beam card, shimmer headline, and gradient button.

taglineZh: 从实拍参考图生成主图、卖点图、场景图
taglineEn: Reference-faithful main, feature, and lifestyle images
descZh: 基于用户上传的真实产品参考图，先锁定形状、颜色、材质、logo 等身份锚点，再按三槽位拍摄计划生成主图、卖点图和生活场景图。有实拍图、要一套电商图片时使用；纯文字概念生成不在 V1 范围。产出三张图加 image-manifest.json 与预览画廊。
descEn: From uploaded real product photos, locks identity anchors (shape, color, material, logo), then follows a three-slot shot plan to generate a main packshot, a feature image, and a lifestyle scene. Use it when reference photos exist and a compact ecommerce set is needed; brief-only concept generation is out of V1 scope. Output is three images plus image-manifest.json and a preview gallery.
outputZh: 三张电商图 + 清单与画廊
outputEn: Three ecommerce images + manifest and gallery
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了三槽位图片方案：主图、卖点标注图与场景图的排版示意，产品图形为占位示意。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows the three-slot plan: main, feature-callout, and lifestyle layouts with placeholder product graphics marked as samples.

taglineZh: 从概念或品牌线索孵化 v2 动画桌宠
taglineEn: Hatch v2 animated pets from concepts or brand cues
descZh: 从角色画、生成图或品牌线索出发，产出 Codex 兼容的 v2 动画桌宠：8x11 精灵图集、9 条标准动画行加 16 个朝向，经过确定性与视觉双重 QA 后打包。要新桌宠、定制吉祥物或修复既有宠物时使用。产出精灵图集、manifest 与 QA 素材。
descEn: From character art, generated images, or brand cues, produces Codex-compatible v2 animated pets: an 8x11 sprite atlas with 9 standard animation rows plus 16 look directions, packaged after deterministic and visual QA. Use it for new pets, custom mascots, or repairing existing ones. Output is the sprite atlas, manifest, and QA artifacts.
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了一只 CSS/SVG 动画桌宠：待机呼吸、眨眼与点击互动，附动画行说明。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows a CSS/SVG animated pet: idle breathing, blinking, and click interaction, with animation-row notes.

taglineZh: 964 个图标定义加一套一致性规则
taglineEn: 964 icon definitions plus one consistency ruleset
descZh: 收录 Kubai Icons 的 964 个图标定义与 20 个徽标，配一份线宽、圆角、留白、色阶的一致性规则和命名约定。页面需要整套图标、新增图标怕风格跑偏、或要批量导出静态 SVG 时使用。产出图标定义、命名关键词表与导出的 SVG 资产。
descEn: Packages Kubai Icons' 964 icon definitions and 20 badges with a consistency ruleset covering stroke width, corner radius, padding, and color steps, plus naming conventions. Use it when a page needs a full icon set, new icons must stay on-style, or static SVGs need batch export. Output is icon definitions, naming tables, and exported SVG assets.
outputZh: 风格统一的 SVG 图标集
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示了一组 24 网格线性图标：统一线宽圆角，附一致性参数与多尺寸对照。
demoCaptionEn: The demo shows a 24-grid stroke icon set with uniform width and radii, consistency parameters, and a size comparison.
